translations.web: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants, and stewards of God’s mysteries.
translations.bsb: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
